kind: conditional synthetic detector superposition using saved MC geometric gains
quadrant_mapping: PROVISIONAL D1 SW/41, D2 SE/67, D3 NE/89, D4 NW/113; physical bottom-view mirror unconfirmed.
blue_assumption: Each LED has its own 3-seed OD3/4/5 MC calculation; gains and MC standard errors are in leakage_MC_summary.json.
desired_signal: All OD3-case MC green collection, including reflected fluorescence and existing source-well mixing. Reflected green fluorescence is not automatically interference.
ideal_comparator: Same green gains, waveforms and sampling, but zero parasitic excitation, ambient and electronic noise. Green gains are held at OD3 means across the rejection sweep; emission filter transmittance is 0.9 in every extra MC case.
units: nW equivalent at green wavelength. Excitation optical nW is multiplied by assumed R470/R520. Ambient and noise are already green-equivalent; no current/voltage prediction.
limits: No measured ambient, noise, responsivity, TIA/ADC transfer, saturation, jitter, biological dynamics. MC sampling/model uncertainty is not noise in the synthetic sweep.

assumed_shot_noise.model: Independent Poisson photoelectron counts from total fluorescence + leakage + DC/flickering ambient. Gate state is held over each 250 us sample bin; true PWM-edge overlap is not integrated. No TIA bandwidth or dark-current model.
